definitions.explanation: Childish word for feces or the act of defecating. The standard word used with children and commonly used in casual adult speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧うんち⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧うんち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けて→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please clean up the dog's poop.

notes:
REGISTER: Childish but widely used. The standard term when talking to or about children, pets, and in casual conversation among adults.

VARIANT: ⟦うんこ→うんこ：23867_unko⟧ is a rougher/cruder variant with the same meaning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- うんち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to poop)
- うんち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to have a bowel movement)

ALTERNATIVES: More formal terms include ⟦{大便|だいべん}→大便：24207_daiben⟧ (clinical) and ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧ (medical). Polite euphemisms include ⟦お{通|つう}じ→お通じ：28832_otsuuji⟧ (bowel movement) and ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧ (lit. 'the big one').
